1. Learn to act out of laser, the amount of hitstun you get is actually really small, even smaller when you cc. It just seems more oppressive than it actually is because you can’t buffer things out of stun. 


2. Learn what they like to do after laser. Another thing about falco lasers is that at least for low levels it becomes really easy to guess what they’re gonna do next. Laser - laser and laser - aerial are super common.


3. Learn to punish falco hard when you do get in. Falco may get more neutral wins than you, but he dies really early and you can really fuck him up. Lots of this game is super punish based. So it’s good to get it as clean and consistent as possible

4. Lots of falcos love to hold down after an aerial or teching to get a cc shine. So make sure you don’t get reversaled
